scope: Automatic local backup retention on go2code; no mobile or API business-rule change

covers: seven daily and four weekly selection
corrupt or unknown snapshots retained for review
exclusive writer and shared restore locks
bounded live output and free-space checks

dockerLogs: Existing rotation remains five files of 10 MB per service
limitations: Retention points are upper targets within the storage budget, not guaranteed when snapshots grow.
The newest valid backup is never deleted to admit a new one; insufficient remaining room causes an explicit failure.
Free-space checks do not constrain writes from other applications on the shared VPS.
Unknown or corrupted backup data requires manual review.
Monitoring is local journald; independent alert delivery remains pending.
Backups remain on the VPS; off-server recovery is deferred.
